Welcome to my channel! Drinks will be enjoyed. Laughs will be had. Science will be learned!

I’m just a small animal emergency veterinarian trying to educate and entertain the pet parent population. If you love science, animals, and/or having a good laugh or two, this is the place for you!

Subscribe for educational and entertaining content, and feel free to post requests in the comments on what you'd like to learn about!
